# Security reporting

Do not post credentials, private media paths, exploitable payloads or personal logs publicly.
Use the repository's private vulnerability reporting channel when enabled, or contact its
maintainer privately. Maintainers should enable a private reporting route before public release.

The starter does not add network or shell capabilities by default. Manifest changes and
bridge expansion require review. Dependency installation and publishing are separate explicit
operations. Agent instructions are not a security boundary.
